caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet with a natural brown color and visible wood grain, positioned in the center. The cabinet consists of three open shelves on the upper portion and a lower section with two paneled doors, each with a round knob and two metal hinges. Surrounding the central cabinet are four detailed sketches enclosed within rectangles, one in each corner of the page. The top left rectangle shows a close-up of a metal hinge in a grayish tone, labeled “full size detail.” The top right rectangle depicts a turned wooden knob, shown in a horizontal orientation and also labeled “full size detail.” The bottom left rectangle presents a vertical cross-section of molding or trim, rendered in a matching wood grain, and includes a scale note. The bottom right rectangle illustrates an oval wooden component with a central screw, colored in light brown with shading and labeled with its scale. All objects are meticulously drawn with attention to texture, form, and proportionality, and the layout is organized with thin lines connecting the detail drawings to the main cabinet.
title: Tewer or Cupboard
